decisive_items: isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine (36 nmol/L)
1.9 cm × 2.8 cm contrast-enhancing mass in bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy
response.rationale: The combination of episodic hypertension, palpitations, diaphoresis, and elevated plasma and urinary normetanephrine levels, along with a contrast-enhancing mass in the bladder wall, strongly supports the diagnosis of paraganglioma.
